capabilities: Chat with Claude about your vault in a sidebar pane
Approve, auto-approve, or deny each note edit Claude proposes
Open each note Claude edits so you can watch the change
Use Claude account connectors, MCP servers, and skills from the chat
Optionally allow shell commands and web access with per-use approval
extras: Desktop only (Obsidian 1.13+; no mobile). Developed and tested on Windows 11; macOS and Linux untested. Manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Messages count toward the Claude plan's usage limits; shell commands are not limited to the vault.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI chat that can work directly on vault notes, and most AI plugins require an API key rather than an existing Claude Code sign-in.

relations.evidence: It runs on the Claude Code installation on your computer and uses the account that you sign in to Claude Code with.
the plugin starts Claude Code through the Claude Agent SDK, with your vault as the working folder

requires.name: Claude Pro, Max, Team, or Enterprise plan, or an Anthropic Console account

summary: Chat sidebar that lets Claude, through a local Claude Code login, read, search, create, and edit vault notes, with approval cards before each edit.
